from datetime import datetime

current_year = datetime.now().year
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password='Qk--@(w')['access_token']

# fetch all recommendations (paginated)
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('recommendations_total', len(all_recs))

# inspect each recommended song: genre + release_date
filtered=[]
for r in all_recs:
    sid = r['song_id']
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = details.get('genre')
    release_date = details.get('release_date')
    # parse release year if available
    release_year = None
    if release_date:
        try:
            release_year = int(str(release_date)[:4])
        except Exception:
            release_year = None
    # consider classical songs: genre equals 'classical'
    if release_year == current_year and genre == 'classical':
        filtered.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': details.get('title'),
            'artist': (details.get('artists') or [{}])[0].get('name'),
            'genre': genre,
            'release_date': release_date,
            'release_year': release_year
        })

print('filtered_classical_this_year', len(filtered))
print(filtered)

from datetime import datetime
current_year = datetime.now().year
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password='Qk--@(w')['access_token']

# Create new playlist
playlist = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title='Spotify Recommended Songs', access_token=access_token, is_public=False)
print('created_playlist', playlist)
playlist_id = playlist['playlist_id']

# Fetch all recommendations (paginated)
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Filter to classical songs released in current_year
filtered_ids=[]
for r in all_recs:
    sid = r['song_id']
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = details.get('genre')
    release_date = details.get('release_date')
    release_year = None
    if release_date:
        try:
            release_year = int(str(release_date)[:4])
        except Exception:
            release_year = None
    if genre == 'classical' and release_year == current_year:
        filtered_ids.append(sid)

print('current_year', current_year)
print('filtered_song_ids', filtered_ids)

# Add each song to playlist
added=[]
for sid in filtered_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    added.append((sid,res))

print('added_count', len(added))

# Verify by fetching playlist details
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
print('playlist_verify', {'playlist_id': playlist_id, 'title': pl.get('title'), 'songs_count': len(pl.get('songs',[]))})
print('playlist_song_ids', [s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs',[])])
